prerequisites.title: Install required tools
notes: Required for downloading and extracting the TrustEdge .deb package.

install.title: Download and install TrustEdge package
notes: Replace {{VERSION}} with the latest version string (e.g., 24.7.2-2187).

tpm_provision.title: Reset and provision TPM2 device
notes: Assumes TPM device is /dev/tpm0; adjust if different.

cert_selfsigned.title: Generate self‑signed ML‑DSA certificates
commands: trustedge certificate -a QS -g MLDSA_44 -o CA.pem -x CA.pem -i ca_csr.cnf -da 3651
trustedge certificate -a QS -g MLDSA_44 -o server.pem -x server.pem -i server_csr.cnf -da 3651 -sk CA.pem -sc CA.pem
notes: Uses the PQC demo CSR files placed in /etc/digicert/keystore/conf.

cert_est.title: Enroll a certificate via EST
commands: trustedge certificate est --algorithm ECC --curve P256 --uri ${EST_URI} --csr-conf sample_est_csr.conf --key-alias eccTestKey --log-level INFO
notes: Replace ${EST_URI} with the actual EST endpoint URL.

cert_scep.title: Enroll a certificate via SCEP
commands: trustedge certificate scep --scepc-serverURL ${SCEP_ENDPOINT} --scepc-serverType GEN_POST --csr-conf sample_scep_csr.cnf --algorithm RSA --size 2048 --key-alias myGenTap --scepc-challengePass ${SCEP_PASS} --scepc-pkiOperation PKCSReq --tap
notes: Replace ${SCEP_ENDPOINT} and ${SCEP_PASS} with your SCEP server URL and challenge password.

run_cli.title: Publish and subscribe using the MQTT client
notes: Demonstrates basic publish and subscribe functionality.

run_agent.title: Configure and start the TrustEdge agent
notes: Bootstrap zip must be prepared beforehand.

pqc_demo.title: Run the PQC demo scripts
notes: The script automates the self‑signed certificate generation steps.

verify.title: Verify generated certificates
notes: Prints certificate details in a readable form.
